activity_summary: You went to evening prayer. Master Thwaite did not turn the glass. He said the morning had had the sermon. Mistress Ansell wanted her house shut. It was a short prayer, and not a second sermon.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Stood the short prayer and went home.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Kept it short, and went back to her door.

quotes.speaker: josias_thwaite
quotes.text: Evening prayer. I am not turning the glass.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: I am not asking for fourteenthly at this hour.
